description: About Insify We are a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. While we started our journey five years ago in the Netherlands, we have since expanded into France and Germany, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is to dominate the European market and become a global leader in AI-powered SME insurance. We aren't just building a company; we’re leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader. Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve. We're looking for a highly motivated Data Analyst who will work closely with Product, Growth, and Insurance teams to understand how customers experience our products and turn that understanding into decisions that shape our roadmap. What you'll be up to (some examples): Define what success looks like for a product or feature, and set the KPIs that measure it — before anyone hands you a spec Design and run A/B tests and experiments, and draw the right conclusions from them, including when results are ambiguous Analyze how users move through our products — conversion, drop-off, retention — and turn that into concrete recommendations for product and growth teams Investigate why performance is changing across our expanding European markets, and help decide where and how we invest next Answer open-ended business questions by exploring the data yourself, not by requesting a pre-defined metrics list Partner directly with product managers, marketing/growth, and occasionally leadership to translate analysis into decisions Own outcomes within your scope — from problem definition to a recommendation that gets acted on Operate in ambiguity and make decisions without perfect information Spot inefficiencies or blind spots in how we measure things, and fix them without being asked This role is a strong fit if you: Have excellent SQL skills: you can calculate any metric in a readable and efficient way Have real, hands-on experience designing or running A/B tests and interpreting the results — this is a must, not a nice-to-have Have done cohort, funnel, or conversion analysis to understand user behavior, not just reported on it Have a track record of defining metrics or KPIs yourself, rather than being told what to measure Have a commercial mindset: you can translate an analysis into a recommendation a non-technical stakeholder can act on Take ownership naturally: you don't wait for perfect instructions and thrive in the "grey area." Can turn messy, ambiguous problems into a clear plan without needing a defined scope handed to you Are comfortable with exposure to modern data tooling (Databricks, dbt, SQL-based transformation) This role is not for you if: You need a list of metrics from stakeholders to know what to measure or investigate You'd rather only build and maintain dashboards than dig into the data yourself and drive decisions from it You are looking for a strict 40-hour work week You need fully defined scopes and stable priorities to perform well You prefer staying high-level, and you don't want to get hands-on with the data itself, from digging into raw numbers to helping shape how it flows through our pipeline You expect long ramp-up periods before taking ownership We offer: Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact Trust and autonomy: you’ll have real ownership and room to make decisions Space to grow and shape your role as Insify evolves A steep learning curve, with support from experienced teammates The opportunity to share in what we’re building, with equity for eligible roles once there’s mutual conviction on fit and impact A welcoming, central Amsterdam HQ where we work closely together: shared lunches, dogs in the office, whiteboards, and fun end-of-week drinks An international, ambitious team that enjoys building meaningful things together

description: About Ethos Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. About The Role Product Operations builds the connective tissue between product and user-facing teams so Ethos can ultimately deliver more value to more users, faster. As a Product Operations Analyst, you’ll work cross-functionally with both customer-facing teams and product and engineering teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. You'll play a key role in strengthening the feedback loop between the field and our product teams, helping surface and resolve issues efficiently. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that is essential to delivering on our mission. use SQL or other data analysis methods to size issues and assess impact Enhance product and engineering teams’ understanding of customer behavior and usage patterns Champion the voice of the customer during the development of new features, product launches, and enhancements to the user experience Build strong relationships with subject matter experts across the organization to surface insights, drive alignment, and contribute to a more consistent and streamlined customer journey Qualifications And Skills 3+ years of experience in operational or analytical roles supporting product and technology teams1+ years of experience with JavaScript, Java, or SQL Strong analytical mindset, technical aptitude, and business acumen with a proactive approach to ownership and problem-solving Deep customer-centric mindset with an understanding of how user experience should shape product and process decisions Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative in environments with limited structure Highly organized and responsive, with a strong sense of accountability when following up on stakeholder requests Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to various audiences and stakeholders Experience working in a high-growth technology company Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field Don’t meet every single requirement? description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Role-specific interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description: Remote in our day-to-day work. On-site when it matters. We work remote by default – focused, efficient, and with full ownership. For larger features, architectural decisions, and real brainstorming sessions, we come together in Berlin – fast, hands-on, and without unnecessary meeting overhead. We use AI to accelerate – not to replace thinking. We design the system, steer the output, and take responsibility for what we ship. Fast where it makes sense. Careful where it matters. Not because you need to be a developer. But because you need to understand what the developers are building. Your Mission We're looking for a Technical Product Owner (f/m/d) who enjoys being right in the middle of Product, Business and Engineering. You'll be part of the engineering team and share responsibility for the applications we build. You'll turn business requirements into clear, technically sound and testable work. You'll coordinate what needs to happen, challenge things when they don't make sense and make sure that "done" actually means done. You will: Bridge Business & Engineering: Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, tickets and acceptance criteria that developers can actually work with. Understand the System: Build a solid understanding of how UI, frontend, backend, APIs and databases interact across our full-stack applications. Test & Investigate: Perform acceptance and smoke testing, work with APIs and validate data to systematically investigate whether something works as intended. Drive Delivery: Organise and orchestrate work within the team, keep dependencies and open questions moving, and take features from idea to production. Own Quality: Help decide whether a feature is ready to go live and develop a strong sense for quality, performance, monitoring and potential risks. Your Skills Core Competencies: Technical Product Thinking: You can break down complex business requirements into clear, structured and testable work and know how to define meaningful acceptance criteria. Hands-on Technical Know-how: You have practical experience with APIs, testing and data validation and understand how frontend, backend and databases work together. Software Development Basics: You understand the fundamentals of Git and modern development workflows, including branches, commits, pull requests and merges. Structured & Precise: You work carefully, pay attention to detail and create tickets and documentation that are clear, concise and easy to understand. Curious & Collaborative: You ask questions, absorb new technical concepts quickly and communicate openly and directly with developers and business stakeholders at eye level. Bonus Skills (The Power-Ups): Experience with tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira or comparable platforms. Background in QA, software testing, technical business analysis or software development. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or similar. Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS. Experience working in an agile software development environment. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Ownership over tickets: You’re trusted with real responsibility, not just tasks. No unnecessary bureaucracy, no micromanagement – we rely on you to take things forward. Build > Talk: We test what works – not what sounds good. Fail fast, learn faster. High standards, low ego: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Direct feedback, honest collaboration, no drama. Stay sharp: Hackathons, conferences, community – we invest in your growth and keep you at the cutting edge. And yes – the fundamentals are covered too: 30 days of vacation + Dec 24 & 31 off, Smart Fridays (4 days week possible), mobility (Germany ticket & JobRad), sports & health offerings, mental health support, corporate benefits, RTL+ access, and more. Your CV is just the starting point. What matters more to us than your resume: a portfolio, a side project, a demo repo – anything that shows you don’t just talk about code, you ship it. Production-ready. Thought through. Done. Welcome to smartclip! We’re just your average group of techies, you know, trying to keep the internet open and defend the European TV industry from Silicon Valley’s giants. Join us! About smartclip smartclip is the adtech development unit of RTL Group — Europe’s leading free-to-air broadcaster group. Our proprietary advertising technology is custom-built for the needs of European broadcasters and publishers — enabling media owners to implement smarter monetisation strategies. We are committed to delivering the most innovative ad experiences spanning in-stream, out-stream, addressable TV, connected TV, audio, and gaming — ultimately empowering brands with true cross-screen storytelling opportunities on all devices. For more information: Please visit www.smartclip.tv and follow us on LinkedIn. Location: Berlin or Hybrid (max. 3 hours travel time to Berlin)

description: Wij hebben stevige softwareambities. AI als onderdeel van het product AI is bij ons geen los experiment: denk aan automatische controle van teksten en specificaties, het detecteren van verschillen tussen artwork-versies en slimmer gebruik van klant- en productiedata. Jij bepaalt samen met gebruikers en stakeholders welke toepassingen prioriteit krijgen; de technische uitwerking ligt bij development en onze AI-specialisten. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Je haalt behoeften op bij collega's en klanten, brengt werkprocessen in kaart en valideert die met de mensen die het werk daadwerkelijk uitvoeren. Je legt een technische keuze of beperking uit aan iemand zonder softwareachtergrond, zonder jargon en zonder het zo te versimpelen dat de uitleg niet meer klopt. Samenwerken met externe developmentpartners naast een intern team, in een omgeving met complexe bedrijfs- en productieprocessen. Wat we wel verwachten: nieuwsgierigheid naar waarom een DTP'er, accountmanager of klant iets op een bepaalde manier doet. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol met echte invloed en duidelijk mandaat: jij bepaalt in grote mate welke problemen we oplossen en prioriteert de backlog binnen de afgesproken kaders. Een directe samenwerking met onze Lead Developer en korte lijnen met de directie. Wij zijn een familiebedrijf van 100 jaar oud, geen concern met zes managementlagen. Direct contact met collega's en klanten, en samenwerking met toonaangevende organisaties zoals Jumbo, Intergamma, FrieslandCampina, Riedel en Bonduelle. description: About Us Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, and more). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way. Clayface is our AI analyst for consumer brands, built on top of that data foundation. Insights and brand teams at consumer goods companies spend days pulling numbers together from retail, social, and syndicated sources before they can start analysing anything. Clayface does that work for them. You ask it a business question and it comes back with an answer: what changed, what is likely driving it, and what to look at next, with the source behind every number. More Info At Clayface: https://www.clayface.ai/ Phyllo: https://www.getphyllo.com/ Our Crunchbase profile: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/phyllo About The Role We are looking for a Product Manager to lead Clayface. You will own what the analyst can do, how it arrives at an answer, and how much a brand team can trust what comes back. That means understanding the questions insights and category teams actually ask, designing the steps the product takes to answer them, and making sure those answers hold up when someone senior pushes back in a meeting. This is a hands-on role. You will be close to the product every day: trying things yourself, reading what it produced, and deciding what to change. It is not an AI strategy role, and it is not a role where you write a brief and wait for engineering to come back with something. What You’ll Own Consumer brand insights The roadmap for Clayface: which business questions we answer well next, which types of analysis we take on, and what we deliberately leave out. Spending real time with insights, brand, and category teams at consumer goods companies. You need to understand how decisions actually get made, what gets asked in the room, and where teams currently get stuck. Turning that understanding into a product that gives useful answers rather than impressive-looking output. An analysis that is technically correct but does not help someone decide anything is a failure. Writing clear requirements an engineer can build from without needing a second meeting. An orchestrated platform for real-world use cases Clayface is not a single prompt. It is a sequence of steps: find the right data, match it across sources, run the analysis, check the result, and explain it clearly. You will design how those steps fit together, which ones the system decides for itself, and where a person should stay in the loop. Making the product work across the messy range of questions real customers ask, not just the handful that demo well. That includes deciding what should happen when the data is thin, when two sources disagree, or when the honest answer is that we cannot tell yet. Working with engineering on what the platform needs so we can add new data sources, categories, and customers without rebuilding it each time. Balancing quality against speed and cost. How long an answer takes and what it costs us to produce are product decisions, not just engineering ones. Quality and Trust Deciding what a good answer looks like for each kind of question, and making sure we measure it rather than assume it. You will set the bar and work with engineering on how it gets checked. The specific methods will change as the product grows, and we expect you to have opinions on that. Making sure every number can be traced back to a source and a time period. Customers make expensive decisions on this output, and a confident wrong answer costs us far more than no answer. Testing properly before things go live. AI products fail quietly rather than loudly, so a few good examples is never enough evidence to ship. Owning the questions enterprise buyers ask about data handling, security, and how their data is used. Working with the team Partnering closely with engineering, design, data, sales, and customer success, and making sure the people who sell and support Clayface understand what it does well and where it is still weak. Connecting the product to outcomes that matter to the business: customers who keep using it, accounts that grow, and deals that close faster. Being the voice of the product internally and with customers, and bringing what you hear back into the roadmap. You’ll be a good fit if Required 5 years in product management, including at least one AI product or feature that real users used and that you measured after launch. You are hands-on with AI products. You have written and improved prompts yourself, looked closely at what the system produced, and worked out why it went wrong. A working understanding of how AI products are put together today: how a model gets the context it needs, how it uses tools and data sources, how multi-step workflows are strung together, and where these systems usually break. Real experience with evaluating AI output. You have set up ways to test quality systematically and used the results to decide what to change. You care about evidence. You check whether an answer is genuinely supported by the data, and you say so when it is not. Comfortable with data. You can write SQL or work in a BI tool, and you are appropriately suspicious of numbers that look too clean. Enough technical depth to have a real conversation with engineers about trade-offs, cost, speed, and data dependencies without needing everything explained from first principles. You do not need to write production code. Clear writing. A good spec from you should prompt specific questions about edge cases rather than confusion about what you meant. Comfortable saying no, including to people who are excited about something that demos well. Preferred A background as an engineer, analyst, or data scientist Experience with consumer goods, retail, or market research data: syndicated data, retailer sell-through, digital shelf, or social listening. Experience building products that sit on top of messy data from many different sources. Familiarity with tools for testing and monitoring AI products. Experience with B2B or enterprise customers, including what their security and procurement teams ask for. An advanced degree in a technical or business field. What We Offer Work from home: work from home or your preferred location. Flexible hours: choose to work in the hours you feel most productive. Innovate and evolve: we’re building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact rather than by title. Real ownership: Clayface is early. You will shape what it becomes rather than inherit someone else’s roadmap. What’s in it for you? We invest in our people and believe in hiring high-potential, humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product. Most AI product roles are about adding a feature to something that already exists. This one is different. Clayface is trying to do the job of an analyst, on real data, for customers who will tell you straight away when the answer is wrong. If that is the kind of problem you want to work on, we would like to hear from you. If you have worked on an AI product before, tell us about something it kept getting wrong and what you did about it. That will tell us more than a cover letter.

description: Wil jij werken aan de groei van een internationaal pionierend travel merk met prachtige bestemmingen in Nederland en Italië? De ene klant is al maanden bezig met het plannen van een zomervakantie in Italië, terwijl een andere juist op zoek gaat naar een last-minute getaway. Dat maakt marketing hier net even anders. Je werkt met een seizoensgebonden product, een langere customer journey en verschillende doelgroepen in meerdere landen. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus team in hartje Amsterdam dat werkt aan een merk waar velen het hele jaar naar uitkijken: vakantie. Nederland, Italië en Duitsland zijn belangrijke markten, maar de ambitie reikt verder. Ook het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Frankrijk, Polen, Tsjechië en Denemarken zijn onderdeel van de internationale groeistrategie. De rol Als Digital & Growth Marketing Manager krijg je een brede, hands-on rol waarin digital marketing, CRM, data en commercie samenkomen. Je kijkt naar de volledige customer journey: van het eerste moment waarop iemand een resort ontdekt tot de boeking, het verblijf en uiteindelijk de volgende vakantie. Je eerste grote project ligt binnen CRM en retentie. Je gaat aan de slag met klantdata, segmentatie, marketing automation en customer lifecycle journeys. Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat iemand op het juiste moment wordt geïnspireerd voor een volgende vakantie? En hoe zorgen we ervoor dat een eenmalige familievakantie een terugkerende klant wordt? Dat zijn precies de vraagstukken waar jij mee aan de slag gaat. Niet één kanaal, maar het hele plaatje CRM & Performance is de basis, maar je rol gaat verder. Je kijkt juist naar hoe alle onderdelen van digital marketing elkaar versterken. Je houdt websites en booking journeys scherp in de gaten. Werkt iets niet zoals het hoort? Dan pak je het op en schakel je met developers, externe specialisten of andere partners om het opgelost te krijgen. Ook campagnes vallen binnen jouw scope. Je werkt aan e-mail, paid media, social en direct mail en kijkt hoe deze kanalen samen bijdragen aan acquisitie, conversie en retentie. Je hoeft niet zelf de specialist in ieder kanaal te zijn. Wel begrijp je hoe de verschillende onderdelen van de marketingmix samenwerken en kun je beoordelen wat goed werkt, waar kansen liggen en welke acties nodig zijn. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er achter de cijfers zit. Je vertaalt analyses naar concrete aanbevelingen, denkt mee over CRO en gebruikt learnings om campagnes en customer journeys steeds verder te verbeteren. Ook onderzoek je hoe AI & Automation kan helpen bij analyses en marketingprocessen. Je hoeft hier geen technische developer voor te zijn. Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om dingen slimmer te maken zijn belangrijker. En misschien wel het leukste: je werkt aan een product waar je het resultaat van je werk letterlijk kunt zien. Een campagne die goed werkt, betekent uiteindelijk dat iemand met het gezin geniet van een heerlijke vakantie in Italië. Je krijgt daarnaast een aantal keer per jaar de mogelijkheid om de resorts in Italië te bezoeken. Zo leer je het product, de klant en de organisatie écht kennen. Wat hebben we van je nodig? Vanaf 2 jaar ervaring binnen digital marketing, growth, CRM, e-commerce of een vergelijkbaar brede marketingrol. Je bent hands-on, commercieel en datagedreven en vindt het leuk om zelf dingen uit te zoeken en voor elkaar te krijgen. Je hebt ervaring met CRM en/of marketing automation en begrijpt de basis van analytics, SEO, conversie en paid media. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI, automation en nieuwe technologie. Ervaring met GA4, Google Tag Manager en Looker Studio is een pré. Je spreekt Nederlands en Engels; Duits of Italiaans is een mooie bonus. Ervaring binnen travel, hospitality, leisure of een andere multi-location consumeromgeving is een pré. Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Bruto jaarsalaris tot €55k incl. vakantiegeld, obv fulltime en afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een brede digital & growth rol waarin je werkt met CRM, data, SEO, campagnes, CRO en automation. Mogelijkheid om veel te leren en te schakelen met externe digital experts De mogelijkheid om te werken aan meerdere Europese markten en doelgroepen. Een aantal keer per jaar de kans om de glamping resorts in Italië te bezoeken. Korting op persoonlijke en familievakanties binnen de organisatie. Een opleidingsbudget om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Lijkt het jou leuk om mee te bouwen aan de groei van een internationaal travel merk en tegelijkertijd bezig te zijn met CRM, data, digital en growth? description: Versterk ons team! Debo is hard aan het groeien in diverse sectoren zoals de bloemteelt en bouw! Steeds vaker zijn we betrokken met leuke langlopende projecten waar de waarde toevoegen bij onze klanten. Niet alleen even een opdrachtje in elkaar zetten en door, maar regelmatig samen om de tafel om te kijken hoe we elkaar zinnig kunnen helpen. Over de rol Hou jij van dingen duidelijk krijgen? Niet zomaar uitwerken wat je verteld wordt, maar actief meedenken met de klant over hoe we een systeem of stuk functionaliteit zo kunnen maken dat het een echte toevoeging wordt? Niet vragen wat er gemaakt moet worden, maar de waarom als basis nemen om tot een goede oplossing te komen. Bij de klant op kantoor zitten om hun ambiance te ervaren en zinnige suggesties te kunnen maken. Dan zijn we mogelijk op zoek naar jou! Onze werkwijze zoekt een Product Owner. Iemand die duidelijk kan krijgen wat de klant wilt en dat om kan zetten in User Stories, zodat developers hiermee aan de slag kunnen. Hoewel het officieel niet tot de taken van een Product Owner hoort, zoeken we ook iemand die geen moeite heeft met zorgen dat een sprint zo soepel mogelijk verloopt; Een refinement vooraf, letten op de sprintplanning en een retro zodat de volgende sprint net een stapje beter kan verlopen. We hebben een aardig beeld van hoe we onze werkwijze prettiger kunnen maken, we missen alleen nog de Product Owner! Voel je je aangesproken door het bovenstaande? Neem vooral contact op! ‍ Wat we vragen Wat we vragen Drie jaar of meer ervaring – We zijn op zoek naar iemand die een goede basis onder de knie heeft, die snapt wanneer principes van toepassing zijn én wanneer juist niet. MBO+ / HBO werk- en denkniveau – Een diploma is geen vereiste; we vinden het belangrijker dat je snel schakelt, logisch nadenkt en nieuwe dingen snel oppakt. De voorkeur face-to-face contact – In een wereld met steeds meer A.I. wordt de persoonlijke benadering steeds beter gewaardeerd. Secure werkwijze – Klanten ontzorgen houdt ook in dat niets je ontglipt. Een 100% efficiënte werkwijze is onhaalbaar, maar hoe benaderen we het en houden we het wel leuk? Spreekt goed ‘klant’ & ‘developer’ – Zet de wensen van de klant om en duidelijke tickets waar je samen met developers mee verder kunt. Bekend met Agile/Sprint – Beide werkwijze zijn een “suggestie”, elk bedrijf doet het anders, maar bieden wel stabiliteit, voorspelbaarheid en zijn niet zomaar bedacht. Klantbegeleiding – Bij het onboarden van een klant geef je de klant duidelijkheid over onze werkwijze. We werken graag lang termijn, meedenkend en transparant, als een partner. ‍
